flagged_claims.claim_text: Total Revenue for FY2023 was $3,355.0 million
flagged_claims.reason: Ulta Beauty is a large-cap S&P 500 retailer with annual revenue historically exceeding $10 billion; a figure of $3.3 billion is drastically understated by a factor of approximately 3x.

flagged_claims.claim_text: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) for FY2023 was $1,919.5 million, compared to $1,112.3 million for FY2022
flagged_claims.reason: COGS decreasing year-over-year while Revenue increased ~38% (from $2,100m to $2,908m) is logically inconsistent for a retail model; additionally, this implies a gross margin of ~62% in 2022, whereas Ulta typically reports gross margins around 30-35%.

flagged_claims.claim_text: Merchandise Inventories balance at the end of FY2023 was $952.0 million
flagged_claims.reason: Inventory declining consistently over three years (2021-2023) while Revenue grows ~60% suggests an impossible improvement in inventory turnover; the absolute scale is also low relative to the company's actual size and store count.
Suspiciously round number compared to other figures (e.g., $2,908.4 million), often indicating estimation or hallucination rather than precise filing data.
